source: Privacy Guardian curated domain taxonomy for deterministic site advisory (Phase 16). Updated September 2026.
edition: category = {recommended: bool|null, rationale: string}. null recommended means unknown (never guessed). Categories drive removal-procedure selection and the per-finding site-advisory badge. Domains are registrable-base keys; subdomains resolve by suffix.

categories.social: social platform - personal profile + content hosting
categories.data-broker: people-search / background-check aggregator - sells aggregated personal data, opt-out required
categories.adult: adult / NSFW content platform - content takedown channel required

spotify.com.rationale: Official music streaming platform with a standard account deletion flow.

x.com.rationale: Mainstream social platform with standard account management.

lastpass.com.rationale: Password manager with official account closure flow.

duolingo.com.rationale: Language learning service with standard deletion flow.

wordpress.com.rationale: Official managed WordPress hosting; standard account deletion.

github.com.rationale: Official software hosting platform with a documented account deletion page.

reddit.com.rationale: Mainstream discussion platform with documented deactivation flow.

facebook.com.rationale: Meta platform with documented account deletion flow.

instagram.com.rationale: Meta platform with documented account deletion flow.

linkedin.com.rationale: Professional networking with documented account closure.

whitepages.com.rationale: People-search aggregator; data removal requires opt-out and can be slow.

spokeo.com.rationale: People-search aggregator selling aggregated personal data; opt-out required.

beenverified.com.rationale: Background-check aggregator; data removal via opt-out flow.

truthfinder.com.rationale: Background-check aggregator; data removal via opt-out flow.

instantcheckmate.com.rationale: People-search aggregator; opt-out flow for data removal.

mylife.com.rationale: People-search/profile aggregator; opt-out and suppression required.

peekyou.com.rationale: People-search aggregator; data removal via opt-out request.
